videos.title: The Two-Party Monopoly
videos.description:
There's real strength in unity, but that's not the story we're told about America every day.

We're told this country is hopelessly divided between left and right. Meanwhile, two private political parties control the process, set the rules, and use closed primaries to keep that system in place.

Open primaries are about breaking that monopoly and returning power back to the people.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #PoliticalPolarization #ElectionReform

videos.title: Stop Drinking The Kool-Aid
videos.description:
What if we're not as divided as we think?

We hear so much from the extreme right and extreme left, but the people on both sides may be more reasonable than we're led to believe.

Drama makes better news, but we need to move beyond the noise and focus on the issues that matter.

#VoterFreedom #PoliticalPolarization #BeyondPartyLines #PoliticalDivision

videos.title: Incentives Shape Our Politics
videos.description:
What if our political system created better incentives for bringing people together?

Instead of putting all the responsibility on individuals, it’s worth looking at the incentives within our government and how they shape our politics.

How can we create a system that encourages us to be peacemakers with each other?

#VoterFreedom #PoliticalPolarization #Democracy #PoliticalReform

videos.title: Stop Putting Voters in Boxes
videos.description:
Voters don’t fit neatly into two boxes.

More and more people don’t see themselves as simply Democrat or Republican. The walls between the two sides are dissolving, and voters aren’t necessarily tied to the political identity they grew up with.

Voters are more than a political label. 

#VoterFreedom #IndependentVoters #BetterChoices #PoliticalIdentity

videos.title: The Primary Has The Power
videos.description:
What happens when the primary is the election that matters most?

In Pennsylvania, 93% of the time over the last 25 years, the primary election has determined who goes to Harrisburg. And when fewer voters participate in the election that decides the outcome, a smaller group can have a bigger say in who represents them.

It’s a dynamic that can shape who gets a voice in our elections.

#VoterFreedom #PrimaryElections #IndependentVoters #VoterChoice

videos.title: Why Millions of Independent Voters Are Locked Out
videos.description:
Have you heard about this?

47% of voters now identify as independent. Yet in 16 states, millions are locked out of elections their tax dollars pay for.

In many districts, the primary IS the election, and the general is just a formality. 

We need to open up primaries so ALL voters can participate.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #BetterChoices

videos.title: Taxation Without Choice
videos.description:
Independent voters pay taxes that fund our elections, yet in closed primary states, they're often forced to choose between joining a political party or sitting out the primaries.

It's time to open the primaries and give independent voters a voice.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #TaxationWithoutChoice

videos.title: What Does It Mean To Be Independent?
videos.description:
More voters, especially younger Americans, are identifying as independent and expressing dissatisfaction with both major parties.
For many, it’s about looking for another route and wanting something different from the current political system.

Independent voters are growing, and independent candidates could be part of what comes next.

#VoterFreedom #IndependentVoters #IndependentCandidates #BetterChoices

videos.title: When Primaries Shape the Outcome
videos.description:
Nearly 90% of House races are decided by just 10% of voters. Through party primaries, we can end up electing more fringe candidates, creating larger political pendulum swings.

Election reform can help create more durable solutions that can actually work.

#VoterFreedom #ElectionReform #OpenPrimaries #BetterChoices

videos.title: Two Things Need to Happen
videos.description:
Here's what can solve America's problems: open primaries and term limits. With those in place, candidates can compromise and appeal to the masses, not just their own constituents.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #TermLimits #BetterChoices

videos.title: Why Nothing Passes
videos.description:
Why does nothing get done in Congress?

Politicians aren't lazy. They're afraid of party bosses. Closed primaries punish compromise and reward gridlock, making it harder for politicians to work across the aisle.

Open primaries force politicians to answer to the public, not the party.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #ElectionReform #PoliticalGridlock

videos.title: It's Fundamentally Broken
videos.description:
Our two-choice political system needs to be shaken up. We can start by allowing independent voters to vote in all taxpayer-funded primary elections - without having to join a private club.

#VoterFreedom #IndependentVoters #ElectionReform #VoterChoice

videos.title: Name Another Job...
videos.description:
Over 90% of elections are decided months earlier in low-turnout primaries. Career politicians aren’t scared of losing their jobs to you. They’re afraid of party insiders running a primary challenger against them.

Open primaries put the power back in the hands of the folks it’s supposed to belong to in the first place: you, the everyday voter.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #VoterChoice #PrimaryReform

videos.title: Should Independents Have to Join a Party?
videos.description:
Independent voters should not have to choose a political party just to have a voice that represents them.

Voters should be able to choose who represents them and make their voices heard without being constrained by joining a party.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #VoterChoice #PrimaryReform

videos.title: What Is Patriotism?
videos.description:
Patriotism isn’t just blind loyalty. It’s not just standing and applauding. It’s not just red, white, and blue.

It’s about honoring minority opinion, minority representation, diversity of thought, and diversity of religion.

Patriotism is loyalty to the Constitution. 🇺🇸 

#Patriotism #Constitution #Democracy #VoterFreedom

videos.title: What's The Real Story?
videos.description:
The hidden political story? 2026 represents the least competitive elections of our lifetimes - just 9.4% of voters effectively elected 88% of Congress. 

When low-turnout party primaries choose the majority of Congress, elected officials are rewarded for appealing to narrow partisan bases. 

Americans deserve competition between candidates, not a coronation of their leaders.

Open primaries can deliver just that.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #VoterChoice #PrimaryReform

videos.title: Make It Make Sense
videos.description:
Independent voters are still waiting for an explanation that makes sense. 🎷🤔

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #ClosedPrimaries #PrimaryReform

videos.title: You Served, But You Can't Vote?
videos.description:
The right to vote is one of the very rights our veterans served to defend. About 55% of younger post-9/11 veterans are independent. In states with closed primary elections, independent voters who are also taxpayers can have no voice in that first round of voting.

And when the first round determines 90% of the winners and losers, the primary can be the election that matters most.

#Veterans #IndependentVoters #OpenPrimaries #ClosedPrimaries #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Let Every Voter In
videos.description:
In closed primary states like Pennsylvania, independent voters are shut out of taxpayer-funded primary elections.

That means candidates can win by appealing to a small portion of voters instead of building support across the political spectrum.

Open primaries put all candidates on one ballot for every voter, creating an incentive for candidates to earn support from more of the people they’ll ultimately represent.

Let’s open the primaries and give every voter a voice.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #VoterChoice #PrimaryReform

videos.title: Polarized Parties
videos.description:
The far left and right demand complete agreement with their views, 100% of the time - leaving no room for compromise.

Are voters still looking at a candidate’s record, experience, integrity, and overall approach? Or have our parties become so polarized that the political middle has shrunk?

#VoterFreedom #PoliticalPolarization #VoterChoice #ElectionReform

videos.title: We Need Better Ideas
videos.description:
When cooperation is punished and division is rewarded, politicians adapt to the system in front of them.

But if our electoral system can be designed to reward division, it can also be redesigned to reward cooperation.

Better outcomes start with better incentives.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #ElectionReform #VoterChoice #BetterGovernment

videos.title: Independents Deserve A Voice
videos.description:
Independent voters shouldn’t have to join a political party just to have a voice in the primary.

In closed primary systems, choosing not to affiliate with a party can mean being shut out of some of the most consequential elections where they live.

Being independent shouldn’t mean being disenfranchised.

#VoterFreedom #IndependentVoters #OpenPrimaries #VoterChoice #PrimaryReform

videos.title: Wait…They Actually Work Together?
videos.description:
Open primaries give everyone a chance to participate in round one.

That means including independent voters, the largest and fastest-growing segment of the electorate, while giving candidates an incentive to speak to people beyond their base.

When candidates have to reach more voters, new political conversations can emerge. 

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #VoterChoice #ElectionReform

videos.title: "I Think It's Un-American"
videos.description:
Voters shouldn’t have to join a political party just to have a voice in a primary election.

When taxpayers are funding elections, the major parties shouldn’t have special privileges that determine who gets to participate.

You shouldn’t have to join a private club to vote.

#OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #VoterChoice #PrimaryReform #VoterFreedom

videos.title: When Political Parties See Independent Voters
videos.description:
Independent voters make up 47% of voters, yet millions are still shut out of taxpayer-funded primary elections.

Maybe it’s time to stop pushing them aside. 😼

#VoterFreedom #IndependentVoters #OpenPrimaries #VoterChoice #PrimaryReform

videos.title: Over Before November
videos.description:
In states like South Carolina and Oklahoma, key races are effectively over before November, when most people vote.

In Alaska, it’s different. The top four candidates advance from the primary to the general election, where those races are decided in November, when most voters participate. 

And voters have more choice when they do.

If we want different outcomes, we have to change the incentives. 

#VoterChoice #ElectionReform #OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Vote Beyond Party
videos.description:
What do Colorado voters think about open primaries?

For some voters, having the freedom to choose a candidate, regardless of party, just makes sense. 

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #Colorado #VoterChoice

videos.title: Closed Primaries Empower The Fringe
videos.description:
Closed primaries can empower the political fringes on both sides.

When the most extreme voices have more influence in our elections, they can have an outsized impact on our politics and the candidates who move forward.

Open primaries are a better reflection of democracy. 

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #ClosedPrimaries #VoterChoice #ElectionReform

videos.title: Fix The System, Change The Politics
videos.description:
The way we run our elections shapes the candidates we get and, ultimately, the kind of politics we see.

From top-two and top-four models to ranked choice voting, the structure of our elections matters. We spend a lot of time focused on political personalities, but not enough time looking at the system itself.

#VoterFreedom #ElectionReform #OpenPrimaries #VoterChoice #RankedChoiceVoting

videos.title: Running To The Extremes
videos.description:
Nearly half of Americans identify as independent, yet our political system continues to push voters and candidates toward the extremes.

In many primary elections, independent voters can’t participate at all. Opening primaries could give these voters a voice and bring a moderating influence to our elections.

But there’s a structural problem: both major parties benefit from the current system, giving them little incentive to change it.

#IndependentVoters #OpenPrimaries #VoterChoice #PrimaryReform #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Open Up The System
videos.description:
Want more competition in our elections? Start with the primaries.

Voters shouldn’t have to be a Democrat or Republican just to participate. Open the primaries, give more candidates a chance to compete, and give voters more choices.

If we want to change the system, we have to open up the system.

#OpenPrimaries #VoterChoice #IndependentVoters #PrimaryReform #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Why Alaska’s Voting System Matters
videos.description:
Alaska changed its voting system in 2020, replacing separate Democratic and Republican primaries with an all-candidate top-four primary and a ranked choice general election.

Supporters say the system gives voters more choices and encourages candidates to appeal beyond their party’s base. Critics say it can be confusing and weaken political parties.

Alaska’s voting system isn’t just about how votes are counted. It’s about which candidates can actually win, how campaigns operate, and how much influence political parties have.

#Alaska #VoterChoice #OpenPrimaries #RankedChoiceVoting #VoterFreed

videos.title: Rocky Steps vs National Debt
videos.description:
You won’t believe this. Every 45 seconds, the national debt raises over $4 million dollars. 

Why are politicians not doing anything about it? 

A lot of people think it’s who we elect. It’s actually how we elect them.

In closed partisan primaries, millions of independent voters are completely shut out. In open primaries, all candidates are on one ballot for every voter.

Let’s change the system. Let’s open primaries in Pennsylvania and across the country.

It’s American. It’s Rocky-like. And it makes sense. 🥊🇺🇸

#OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #ElectionReform #RockySteps #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Alaska Has A Better Way To Vote
videos.description:
Alaska ripped up the traditional party primary playbook.

Every voter, regardless of party, gets the same ballot. The top four candidates advance, and voters rank their choices in November.

The result? Turnout is up, toxic campaigning is down, and leaders have more incentive to work across party lines and represent the majority.

Alaska is proving that when you change the rules of Election Day, you can change how politicians behave every day after.

#Alaska #OpenPrimaries #VoterChoice #ElectionReform #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Alaska Gets Things Done
videos.description:
The results in Alaska have been positive. Since voters approved the state’s top-four all-candidate primary in 2020, the number of voters casting a meaningful ballot has increased by nearly 60%.

Today, a cross-partisan governing majority is working on issues that matter to Alaskans—from passing the budget on time to funding education. When elected officials are accountable to more voters, they’re incentivized to do their jobs.

#Alaska #TopFourPrimary #VoterChoice #ElectionReform #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Independents Are On The Rise In America
videos.description:
Independent voters are reshaping American politics. 

A new CNN poll finds that 47% of Americans now identify as politically independent—the highest level in more than a decade. The political landscape is changing, and independent voters are leading the shift.

#IndependentVoters #RiseOfIndependents #BeyondTheTwoParties #Democracy

videos.title: Our Republic for the Next 250 Years
videos.description:
Philadelphia’s Independence Hall is the birthplace of American democracy and the U.S. Constitution.

Nearly 250 years ago, America started a revolution based on the belief that political power should come from the people. Yet Pennsylvania’s election system excludes nearly 1.4 million independent voters simply because they aren’t Democrats or Republicans.

That must change. To keep the republic strong for the next 250 years, everyone should be able to vote in every election and choose leaders who truly represent the people.

#IndependenceHall #IndependentVoters #Pennsylvania #America250

videos.title: Independents Are Locked Out
videos.description:
39 million Americans aren’t affiliated with either major party—yet millions are locked out of choosing who will represent them.

In more than 20 states and Washington, D.C., closed or partially closed primaries restrict independent voters from participating unless they join a party.

Voting shouldn’t require joining a club.

#IndependentVoters #OpenPrimaries #VotingRights #Voterfreedom

videos.title: What's Happening In Michigan?
videos.description:
Are party politics distorting our election outcomes?

People are frustrated with politics and with both parties. When more fringe candidates are able to win in the primary, it can lead to distorted election outcomes that simply aren't healthy. 

#OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #ElectionReform #PrimaryElections

videos.title: Millions of Independent Voters Are Shut Out
videos.description:
Millions of independent voters are shut out of the elections that often determine who wins. 

With more than 92% of congressional districts considered noncompetitive, many races are effectively decided before November. If we believe in democracy, every voter deserves to have their voice heard, regardless of party affiliation.

#OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #ElectionReform #Democracy

videos.title: Over Before Your Vote
videos.description:
Less than 10% of congressional races are competitive. By the time you get to the general election, many races are already over. 

That means if you're an independent, you often don't have a meaningful vote until November, when the outcome has already been decided. There has to be a way to bring independent voices into the conversation. 

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #ElectionReform #Democracy

videos.title: Crowning Congress
videos.description:
More than one out of every three members of Congress secured their reelection without having to earn a single vote. Why? Because there wasn't a single other candidate running against them in their primary, and their general election wasn't competitive. 

Americans deserve competition, not coronations. The way to restore competition is by reforming the primary process. With all-candidate open primaries, we can unlock more competitive general elections and open the pipeline for more Americans to consider running for office. That's how we refresh and renew our democracy.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrima

videos.title: Ballots In Name Only
videos.description:
In 32 states, not a single congressional district will be competitive in 2026, and 60% of state legislative races will go uncontested. The real election scandal is hiding in plain sight: Too many voters go to the polls without meaningful choices.

If we want to fix America’s political system, we need primary election reform and meaningful ballots, not Ballots in Name Only.

#BallotsInNameOnly #PrimaryReform #BetterChoices #VoterFreedom

videos.title: The Primary Is the Whole Ballgame
videos.description:
83% of congressional districts are decided in the primary. The primary is the whole ballgame.

No one should be forced to join a political party just to have a voice in our democracy. There are now more independents in our country than either Democrats or Republicans. Our elections belong to We the People, and every voter should be able to participate in the elections that matter most.

#OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #VoterFreedom #ElectionReform

videos.title: We Need more Competition
videos.description:
Competition matters in every part of our lives. So why is politics limited to just two choices?

When politicians know you'll have to choose one of them, especially in safe districts, they have less reason to solve problems for everyone.

Open primaries create more competition by giving voters more than two realistic candidates on the ballot. When politicians have to compete for every vote, they have a reason to serve everyone—not just their party.

That's how we make America work again.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #MoreCompetition #ElectionReform #Democracy

videos.title: A Healthy Democracy
videos.description:
Open primaries help democracy. Period.

At a time when so many Americans—including those who still belong to a political party—aren't happy with the way our system works, we should be creating more choice, more voice, and more opportunity for voters.

Open primaries aren't about eliminating political parties. They're about giving them a chance to adapt, better represent voters, and ultimately survive. A democracy works best when it's flexible, responsive, and open to change—not rigid and stuck.

More choice. More voice. A healthier democracy.

#OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #Democracy #ElectionR

videos.title: The Case for Open Primaries
videos.description:
Most people wait until November to vote, but in many districts, the real election happens in the primary.

With so many congressional districts no longer competitive, primaries often decide who represents us. Yet in many states, independent voters are still shut out.

If primaries are publicly funded, every voter should have a voice. Because by November, many of the decisions have already been made.

Every voter deserves a voice. Every election should matter.

#OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #ElectionReform #Democracy

videos.title: Closed Primaries Undermine Election Integrity
videos.description:
There's a lot of talk about election integrity. Moving to a closed primary system actually undermines election integrity. A very small group of citizens ends up selecting who the final candidates on the ballot will be, and in many states, independents aren't even allowed to participate. 

In an open primary system, Congress can represent every single person in their congressional district. 

Why wouldn't you create a system that encourages candidates to represent and earn votes from across the spectrum? 

#ElectionIntegrity #OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #Democracy

videos.title: What's the Impact of Gerrymandering?
videos.description:
Most congressional races are already decided before November. The latest estimates are as high as 90%. Everyone knows who's going to win because the primary is the only election that counts.

Top-two open, nonpartisan primaries create real competition by giving every voter the chance to choose among all the candidates. If it's a publicly funded election system, then everybody should be able to participate. 

#OpenPrimaries #ElectionReform #VoterFreedom #Democracy

videos.title: Closed Primaries Vs Open Primaries
videos.description:
In most elections, the real contest isn't the general election—it's the party primary. That's where the candidates are chosen, the field gets narrowed, and the teams are picked.

In many states, you have to be registered with a political party to vote in that primary. In 16 states, independent and unaffiliated voters can be completely shut out.

Open primaries offer a different approach: one ballot, every candidate, every voter. No party gate. No separate entrance. Just a system where every voter gets the same ballot.

#OpenPrimaries #PrimaryElections #EveryVoter #VoterFreedom

videos.title: It Starts With Open Primaries
videos.description:
We pay for our primary elections. We pay for the ballots, the workers, and everything it takes to run them. So why are millions of voters still locked out? Open primaries give every voter the freedom to participate and help elect candidates who better represent the people.

#OpenPrimaries #ElectionReform #EveryVoter #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Two Private Clubs
videos.description:
Our democracy shouldn't be run by two private clubs.

Voters deserve more than the same two choices over and over again.

A single open primary puts every candidate on equal footing and gives every voter an equal voice.

That sounds like freedom.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #ElectionReform

videos.title: The Primary Problem
videos.description:
One of the biggest solvable problems in our politics is partisan primaries.

Millions of voters, especially independents, are shut out of primary elections in many states.

The solution? Open primaries that let every voter vote for any candidate.

It's a practical reform that's already gaining momentum across the country.

#OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #IndependentVoters #ElectionReform

videos.title: The Rise of Independent Voters
videos.description:
Independents are the fastest-growing group of voters.

So why should they have to join a political party they don't support just to vote?

That's not how a functioning democracy should work.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #Democracy

videos.title: Frustrated with Politics?
videos.description:
Frustrated with politics?

The problem isn't just the people—it's the incentives.

When partisan primaries decide most elections, candidates have an incentive to appeal to a small group of the electorate instead of the majority of voters.

Open primaries and ranked choice voting create more representative turnout, more representative results, and encourage candidates to work across the aisle to solve problems.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #RankedChoiceVoting #ElectionReform

videos.title: Safe Seats Change Everything
videos.description:
More and more districts are being drawn as safely Republican or safely Democratic. When that happens, the real competition shifts to the primary, where a small group of the most partisan voters often decides who advances.

If we want leaders who represent more Americans, we need a system that rewards candidates who can earn support beyond the extremes.

#VoterFreedom #OpenPrimaries #BetterChoices #ElectionReform

videos.title: We Need Better Choices
videos.description:
How did we end up with a system that empowers political parties to put forward candidates who aren't the best people for the job?

Maybe it's time to take a fresh look at the process and make sure we're doing a better job of vetting candidates before they make it onto the ballot.

After all, this is the board of directors for America.

#VoterFreedom #BetterChoices #ElectionReform #Democracy

videos.title: No Football For You
videos.description:
Millions of independent voters are locked out of the election that often determines the winner.

Open primaries mean one ballot for every voter and every candidate.

Let everyone into the game. 🏈

#OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #ElectionReform #Democracy

videos.title: Is Congress Performing Instead Of Governing?
videos.description:
Congress is becoming increasingly performative.

Too often, the focus is on creating viral moments for social media instead of working together to solve problems.

When we reward the loudest voices, we stop rewarding the people who are actually negotiating, finding common ground, and doing what's in the best interest of the country.

Open primaries create different incentives. Instead of appealing to a small group of partisan voters, candidates have to recruit support from across the political spectrum because, at the end of the day, they're elected to represent everyone in their district, not

videos.title: A Warning from George Washington
videos.description:
George Washington warned that political parties could become more focused on serving themselves than serving the people.

Today, millions of independent voters are shut out of taxpayer-funded primaries simply because they don't belong to a political party.

Open primaries are the people's primaries—where every eligible voter has an equal voice.

#GeorgeWashington #OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #VoterFreedom

videos.title: The Real Story: 93% Didn't Vote
videos.description:
Everyone is talking about who won New York's primary. 

But here's the number that should get more attention: Only 7% of eligible voters cast a ballot. 

When 93% of eligible voters didn't vote, can we really say what message is resonating?

#VoterFreedom #NewYork #PrimaryElection #EveryVoteCounts

videos.title: A Win For Independents In DC
videos.description:
A major victory for independent voters in Washington, D.C.

The D.C. Council approved funding to implement semi-open primaries, opening the door for 85,000 independent voters to participate in primary elections.

#OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #VoterFreedom #MoreChoices

videos.title: Open The Primaries
videos.description:
A lot of voters in both parties don't identify with the extremes. Many of those voters are shut out of primary elections.

It’s simple. Open the primaries. Let independent and non-party voters participate. 

Make sure the person who gets elected has a majority.

#OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #ElectionReform #MoreChoices #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Who Speaks For New York?
videos.description:
The real story isn't who won New York's primary.

The people of New York have no meaningful expression of what they actually want because independents are  locked out of primaries.

The solution is simple: give power back to voters by giving them more choices.

#NewYork #OpenPrimaries #VotingRights #IndependentVoters #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Independent Voters in Colorado
videos.description:
Independent voters are celebrating in Colorado - because they get to vote in primaries! 

But, they have to choose a party’s ballot to vote. There is a better way. 

With open, all-candidate primaries - every voter gets the opportunity to vote for any candidate - regardless of political party. 

It’s a system that increases voter turnout and incentivizes candidates to appeal to a much broader set of voters - not just the fringes of the party. 

#Colorado #COPolitics #IndependentVoters #OpenPrimaries

videos.title: Low Turnout. Big Impact.
videos.description:
Low-turnout primaries can leave major decisions in the hands of a small percentage of voters.

#OpenPrimaries #VotingMatters #MoreVoicesMoreChoices #voterfreedom

videos.title: Closed Primaries are Anti-Free Market
videos.description:
Competition in business is good! So why don’t we allow for more competition in our elections?

Closed primaries shut out voters. Open primaries allow all voters into the process - a truly American, free market way to vote. 

In open primaries, candidates have to recruit and attract voters from across the political spectrum - not just a narrow slice of the most extreme. 

#FreeMarkets #Politics #PrimaryElection #OpenPrimaries

videos.title: New York’s Closed Primary
videos.description:
In New York’s primary on Tuesday, more than 1 million registered independent voters can’t participate. 

Why? Because New York runs closed party primaries that exclude them.

This isn’t just unfair - it’s undemocratic. Every taxpayer funds these elections. 

Every eligible voter should have the freedom to participate.


#NYPrimary #Knicks #ClosedPrimary #NewYork #IndependentVoter

videos.title: What are the 3 P’s?
videos.description:
The biggest impact in politics would be fixing the system itself. Open primaries do that. 

All candidates. One ballot. Every voter. It can be a solution for our political polarization.

Bill Gurley and Kara Swisher discuss how open primaries give more voters a voice and open the doors to more representative candidates. 

@billgurley8486  @onwithkaraswisher 

#OpenPrimaries #KaraSwisher #BillGurley #EveryVoter #PrimaryElections

videos.title: A Win In New Mexico
videos.description:
In 2025, New Mexico passed a bill that partially opened its primaries to independent voters.

Now, more than 370,000 independent voters can participate in primary elections.

By opening primaries to independent voters it allows for better representation.

This is monumental for young voters, a majority of whom are independent, to have their voices heard in the most consequential election—the primary election.

#OpenPrimaries #IndependentVoters #NewMexico #VoterFreedom

videos.title: We Want Choices
videos.description:
As Americans, we want options in everything.

So why should voting be any different?

Open primaries create more choice by encouraging candidates to speak to more voters, not just their party.

More voices. More options. More participation.

#OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #Alaska #IndependentVoters #Democracy

videos.title: Not Party Driven
videos.description:
A lot of Alaskans aren’t defined by party labels. They’re independent.

Open primaries give voters the opportunity to look beyond party labels and choose the candidates who align with their values.

More choices. More freedom. More voices.

videos.title: More Than Two Choices?
videos.description:
Open primaries are about choice.

Think of it like a candy bucket. You look at all the options and ask: Who speaks to my values? What matters to me?

#OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #Democracy #ElectionReform #IndependentVoters

videos.title: Why Ranked Choice Voting Matters
videos.description:
Too many politicians are winning elections without majority support.

That’s the problem.

Ranked Choice Voting is a simple system that helps ensure elected officials actually represent the majority of voters, not just the loudest minority.

“Don’t read the hype. Do your own homework.” 

#RankedChoiceVoting #ElectionReform #Democracy #OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Closed Primaries = Political Gridlock
videos.description:
Half the states in this country have closed primaries.

That means if you’re a registered independent, you’re excluded from voting in 50% of elections.

And the impact doesn’t stop there. When elected officials are thinking about the 18% who vote in primaries instead of 100% of their constituents, it creates gridlock and makes it harder to govern.

That’s a problem for all voters.

#OpenPrimaries #VoterFreedom #IndependentVoters #Democracy #ElectionReform

videos.title: Closed Primaries Fuel Extremes
videos.description:
Why do politicians cater to the extremes instead of the majority?

Because in a closed primary, the biggest risk for elected officials isn’t losing the general election. It’s losing to the loudest, most organized voices in their own party.

That’s how frustrated majorities get left behind.

#OpenPrimaries #Democracy #IndependentVoters #ElectionReform #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Let All Americans Vote
videos.description:
Millions of independent voters are being locked out of elections.

Closed partisan primaries reward the extremes instead of the majority of Americans, and open primaries and ranked choice voting can help fix it.

#OpenPrimaries #RankedChoiceVoting #IndependentVoters #Democracy #Voterfreedom

videos.title: Locked Out Of Voting?
videos.description:
Millions of independent voters are shut out of primary elections they help pay for.

#OpenPrimaries #ElectionReform #IndependentVoters #FairElections #VoterFreedom

videos.title: Stop Shutting Voters Out
videos.description:
Why are independent voters treated like they matter less?

In some states, you have to join a party just to vote in a primary. That means millions of voters are shut out before the real decision even happens.

Open primaries change that.
They give every voter a voice and push candidates to represent everyone, not just a party.

@robsandia

#VoiceMatters #BeHeard #openprimaries #ElectionReform #VoterFreedom

#OpenPrimaries #FixTheSystem #voterfreedom

videos.title: We Have A Problem
videos.description:
Why are our politics so extreme? The one solvable problem is our closed primary system. Closed systems amplify the fringes, while silencing independents and restricting voter freedom. The fix is simple: Open the primary system. Let every voter choose the best candidate for both sides, not just the candidate who appeals to the most radical fringes of its party.
